name: Show location
description:
##  GET /api/v1/locations/{id}

Displays a location by id
whenToUse: Fetch one location's full details by its hashed id; use get_locations to search across many instead.

queryParameters.name: index
queryParameters.description:
Replaces the default response index from data to a user specific string

ie.

```html
  ?index=new_index
```

response is wrapped

```json
  {
    'new_index' : [
      .....
    ]
  }
```
